prompt: List all the prime ministers of india sorted by year
response:

5. Morarji Desai (1977-1979)
6. Charan Singh (1979-1980)
7. Vishwanath Pratap Singh (1989-1990)
8. Chandra Shekhar (1990-1991)
9. P. V. Narasimha Rao (1991-1996)
10. Atal Bihari Vajpayee (1998-2004)
11. Manmohan Singh (2004-2014)
12. Narendra Modi (2014-present)
